title: Yandex Takes a Second Data Center Hit in 48 Hours
summary: A news report from United24 Media covering the targeting of Yandex data centers during the Russia-Ukraine conflict, with this being the second such facility hit within 48 hours, affecting Russia's largest website infrastructure.
problem_solved: This is news reporting, not a technical solution - it reports on military operations targeting digital infrastructure during armed conflict.
why_valuable: Provides real-time coverage of how the Ukraine-Russia conflict is affecting critical digital infrastructure, including Russia's largest internet services.
